test_agent_vectors.Breadcrumbs.test_docs.doc: Real false alarms from the calibration scan (Nov 2026): a path, a CLI flag, a compound word, a heading.

test_agent_vectors.Breadcrumbs.test_shor.doc: Private corpus round 7: one short hidden sentence, a meta description or an alt text addressed to shopping agents.

test_agent_vectors.Breadcrumbs.test_stee.doc: Private corpus round 7: the 'skip' and 'steer' payloads in 50 carriers; one of each kind is public here.

test_agent_vectors.FileNames.test_the_na.doc: A file name is text the agent reads (ls, find, Glob, unzip -l, git status): it can carry the order with any separator.

test_agent_vectors.Listings.test_listing.doc: `ls && grep ...` prints source lines too; backticks in code are not file names.

test_agent_vectors.Targeted.test_targete.doc: Private corpus round 7: the same sentence as an identifier, CamelCase with a glued word, spaced letters.

test_cli_hooks.Hooks.test_file_swap_afte.doc: Trust is bound to the exact bytes (SHA-256), not to name, size or time - a swap re-opens the gate.

test_directives_ocr.OcrChecks.test_singl.doc: corpus 14: the page says 'divisible by 3', the text layer says 7.

test_directives_ocr.OcrChecks.test_syste.doc: corpus 21: drawn a/b extract as b/a everywhere - OCR shows the page says something else.

test_email.Email.test_body_asking_for_ke.doc: Visible social engineering, no AI address: the request itself is the finding (bench mail-body-secret-request).

test_email.Email.test_readable_line_in_a.doc: OCR reads 'AI' as 'Al'; the check must still see the address to AI readers.

test_hooks2.DevUnlock.test_taint_suspend.doc: Changed 2026-11-20 at Stefan's request (no prompts for repo edits): a finding keeps the unlock for ordinary repo

test_hooks2.ReaderGate.test_output_targe.doc: A stale flagged file that a command is about to overwrite must not block the command that rewrites it.

test_hooks2.ReaderGate.test_readers_outs.doc: Any command that takes a document as an argument reads it, unless it is known not to print content.

test_hooks2.StagedActions.test_a_script_.doc: Written in harmless steps, then run: `bash helper.sh` says nothing, the file says everything.

test_hooks2.StagedActions.test_control_c.doc: A copied command can carry bytes that end the paste early or rewrite the clipboard.

test_hooks2.StagedActions.test_scripts_a.doc: Except download-and-run, which asks in every session since 2026-11-20 (test_hooks3.LocalScripts).

test_hooks2.Taint.test_secret_plus_netwo.doc: Even without an earlier finding: these two shapes are how an injected instruction pays off.

test_hooks3.CISecrets.test_ordinary_secr.doc: Twin: a secret handed to a step through env, and a token sent to the forge's own API.

test_hooks3.LocalScripts.test_benign_set.doc: Twin: venv, requirements and a self-signed certificate, no download that is run.

test_pdf.Synthetic.test_sheet2_replica.doc: The exact construction found in Exercise Sheet 2 (24 Oct 2026).

test_pdf.Synthetic.test_tounicode_zero_w.doc: Real zero-width trap: a glyph whose extracted text is U+200B.

test_redteam2.CoveredText.test_text_cove.doc: Text layer has a directive, an opaque picture of the real task is drawn over it: render diff sees ink,

test_redteam3.TaskModifiers.test_actualt.doc: Printed a(b*c+ab)*c*, extractors read a(b*c+ab)* - only the per-span glyph audit sees the difference.

test_redteam3.TaskModifiers.test_coverin.doc: The inverse: a white box hides 'c*' from the student, the text layer keeps it.
